question: How Does IO-Link Work?
body_html:
IO-Link works as a point to point digital link between one IO-Link master port and one sensor or actuator, defined in IEC 61131-9. It uses the standard 3 wire sensor cable, up to 20 m long.

Over this link the device sends its process value digitally, passes diagnostic data and receives parameter settings from the controller. The master gathers data from several devices and passes it to the PLC, DCS or SCADA over PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, PROFIBUS or Modbus.
